entities.summary: Henri Marthe Sylvie Rolin was a Lawyer, Diplomat, Senator, President of the Belgian Senate, Minister, Minister of State, Judge then President of the European Court of Human Rights, President of the Institute of International Law, and Professor at the Free University of Brussels.
